name: Restore sensory innervation of regenerated skin
description: Regenerated or grafted skin regains touch, temperature and pain sensation comparable to uninjured skin, with nerve fibres reaching Merkel cells and follicles.

grade.note: In a human tissue-engineered skin model, neurotrophic factors enhanced angiogenesis, coupling innervation to vascular growth in vitro (Blais 2013). Skin organoids form sensory nerve bundles targeting Merkel cells in culture (Lee 2020). Clinical experience that sensation in grafted skin recovers partially and slowly is common knowledge but is not sourced here, so it does not raise the rung.
